title: Full-Stack Developer (ERP & AI Automation)
description:
**Job Description: Full-Stack Developer (ERP & AI Automation)**

**Industry:** Construction, Real Estate, Apartment Rentals & Property Maintenance  
**Employment type:** Full-time / Freelancer  
**Location:** Coimbatore / Remote / Hybrid  
**Experience:** 3 - 6+ years  
**Reports to:** CTO / Head of Technology / Managing Director

**About the Role**

We are building a custom, unified ERP platform for a business that runs construction projects, real estate development, and apartment rentals and maintenance across multiple sites. We are looking for a full-stack developer who can combine several open-source applications (accounting, CRM, project management, HRMS, document management and others) into **one application with a single dashboard**. You will also add AI-driven automation to reduce manual work and improve decisions across all projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**ERP development**

● Design, build and maintain the custom ERP across modules such as projects, procurement, inventory, contractors, billing, HR and payroll, accounting, tenants, leases, rent collection and maintenance.

● Support **multiple projects and properties** within one system, with project-wise budgets, costing, progress tracking and role-based access.

● Build REST/GraphQL APIs and backend services (Python primary, Java where required).

● Build responsive front-end interfaces in React and JavaScript/TypeScript.

**Open-source integration**

● Evaluate, customize and integrate open-source tools (for example ERPNext/Odoo, Metabase/Superset, Keycloak, Nextcloud, OpenProject) into one unified application.

● Implement single sign-on, shared data models and API or webhook connections between systems.

● Build a **central dashboard** showing project status, cash flow, occupancy, rent dues, maintenance tickets, procurement and site progress.

**AI and automation**

● Automate workflows such as invoice and bill data extraction (OCR), purchase approvals, rent reminders, lease renewals and maintenance ticket routing.

● Build AI features such as chatbots or assistants for tenants and staff, cost and delay prediction, anomaly detection in expenses, and automated reports.

● Integrate LLM APIs, with vector search or RAG over project documents, contracts and drawings.

**Engineering practice**

● Design database schemas and optimize queries (PostgreSQL/MySQL).

● Write clean, tested, documented code and use Git-based workflows and code reviews.

● Deploy and maintain applications using Docker and CI/CD, on cloud or on-premise servers.

● Handle data security, backups, audit logs and access control.

● Work with management, site engineers, accountants and property managers to turn business needs into features.

**Required Skills**

● **Python:** Django, FastAPI or Flask; scripting and automation.

● **React.js** and modern **JavaScript/TypeScript**, HTML5 and CSS3.

● **Java**, preferably Spring Boot, for services and integrations.

● Strong **SQL** and relational database design; PostgreSQL or MySQL.

● REST API design and third-party system integration.

● Experience customizing or integrating **open-source ERP/CRM/BI tools**.

● Git, Docker, Linux and basic cloud deployment (AWS, Azure or GCP).

● Understanding of authentication and authorization (JWT, OAuth2, SSO).

**Preferred Skills**

● Experience with ERPNext/Odoo (Frappe or OWL frameworks).

● Practical AI/ML experience: OpenAI/Claude/open-source LLM APIs, LangChain, OCR, scikit-learn, or workflow tools such as n8n.

● Dashboards and BI (Metabase, Superset, Power BI, Grafana).

● Message queues and caching (Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ).

● Domain knowledge of construction (BOQ, RA bills, subcontractor management), real estate (units, sales, payment schedules) or property management (leases, rent, maintenance).

● Mobile-friendly or PWA development for site and field staff.

● Payment gateway, GST/tax, WhatsApp/SMS/email integrations.

**Qualifications**

● Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or equivalent practical experience.

● A portfolio or examples of ERP, business-application or automation projects.

**What We Expect From You**

● Ability to take a business problem from requirements to deployment independently.

● Clear communication with non-technical users.

● A practical, cost-conscious approach that favors proven open-source tools over building from scratch.

● Ownership of quality, security and maintainability.

**What We Offer**

● Work on AI automation in a traditional industry.

● Competitive salary and room for growth.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person
